title: John Paul and Lily go on telepathic dates from different floors

tellings.quote: well often they'll be on different floors of the house and but they're communicating

plain: A documentary filmmaker, Ky Dickens, who has made a film about nonspeaking young people said to communicate by telepathy, tells of two of them, John Paul and Lily, in Atlanta, Georgia, around 2023. Relaying what a person named Libby told her, Dickens says the two often sit on different floors of the house yet still communicate, like going on dates. If true, it would mean minds can talk without words or being in the same room.
